title: Row-count-independent prompt GEMMs: cuBLASLt pinned to one split-K-free algorithm per shape and format, for 16-bit, FP8, MXFP8, MXFP4 and NVFP4 operands

lt-dense.what: BF16, FP16 or FP32 (no TF32) operands into a 16- or 32-bit output: cuBLASLt's dense tensor-core GEMMs, one algorithm a shape (pin(); the knobs are read in Python, at pin time)

REP_ROWS.what: the row count whose cuBLASLt heuristic list is searched for split-K-free algorithms

CHOICE.what: which of the list's distinct row-exact algorithms is pinned (the last one where fewer are listed)

yardstick.library: cuBLASLt unpinned through torch (torch.matmul, torch.mm with out_dtype for FP32 outputs): its heuristic's algorithm at each row count, split-K included

lt-fp8.what: FP8 E4M3/E5M2 operands, unscaled or with tensor or row scales: cuBLASLt's FP8 GEMMs (sm_89 and newer), one algorithm a shape

REP_ROWS.what: the row count whose cuBLASLt heuristic list is searched for split-K-free algorithms

CHOICE.what: which of the list's distinct row-exact algorithms is pinned (the last one where fewer are listed)

yardstick.library: cuBLASLt unpinned through torch._scaled_mm (unit tensor scales, FP32 output): its heuristic's algorithm at each row count

lt-block.what: block-scaled MXFP8, MXFP4 and NVFP4 operands: cuBLASLt's block-scaled GEMMs (sm_100 and newer), one algorithm a shape

REP_ROWS.what: the row count whose cuBLASLt heuristic list is searched for split-K-free algorithms

CHOICE.what: which of the list's distinct row-exact algorithms is pinned (the last one where fewer are listed)

yardstick.library: cuBLASLt unpinned through torch._scaled_mm (NVFP4, the same blocked scales): its heuristic's algorithm at each row count; the global alpha left out
